## Root Cause And Evidence
- Regression `20cf91a66` moved `<zs-pagination>` into table-wrap and changed panel/table-wrap from `flex:1; min-height:0` to `flex-shrink:0`; `b95646281` is the normal state and already contains the total/rows fallback in committed code; git status was clean with no prior modifications.

- 2026-11-27 hop4 DOM/live test disproved CSS clipping: wrap was `flex-shrink:0; overflow:hidden` with `.pagination-container` child, hidden only because `total=0`; browser-only `total=8` changed display `none`→`flex`, rendered `共 8 条记录`, and stayed unclipped (`clientHeight===scrollHeight`).

The ZenTao image was the list view (`cardValue==1`, getTable path) with 8 rows and no pagination, so current code should set total=8 and show it; suspicion was old deployment vs target-state data layering.
- hop9 (2026-11-27): deployed 8120 bundle `ScopeSelectDialog-BxBMa94r.js` already contains the b95646281 fix — `getTable` minified to `const e=s.rows||s.data?.rows||[],t=Number(s.total??s.data?.total);this.tableList=e,this.total=t>0?t:e.length`, identical to source :396-399 — so the old-deployment theory is disproved.

No session-list sorting tool exists; new_once creates a fresh session; if delivery sinks, manually pin.

## 问题与目标
- 链接 `http://zentao-biz.zhi.com/index.php?m=bug&f=view&bugID=7047`；标题「【惠山物业】业主账户开户详情：新增开户明细页无分页，放大/缩小分辨率都不显示」。
